headline: Data Exfiltration Confirmed in Xiamen Zhengxin Ransomware Attack
body: Xiamen Zhengxin Rubber Industry Co., Ltd. has confirmed that data exfiltration occurred during the recent ransomware attack on its systems. The company has assured its partners that no customer or downstream impacts have been identified as a result of the data theft.
